title: Tribunal awards ₹31.43 lakh compensation to kin of Thane man killed in 2020 road accident
description: In its order on July 8, the MACT directed the owner of a tempo involved in the accident and its insurer to jointly and severally pay the amount to the family of the victim, Rajaram Narayan Mhatre, with 9% interest per annum from the date of the petition
